verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy-posture question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of retention controls such as retention periods, lifecycle or expiry policies, or deletion guarantees for customer or AI data. The only related item is CloudFormation stack deletion (aws-docs-7), which is an adjacent infrastructure-teardown feature rather than a data retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit.
